title: IQ Test for LLMs: An Evaluation Framework for Uncovering Core Skills in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset, a multiple-choice benchmark that probes social-bias sensitivity under controlled world-knowledge settings, and using factor analysis to identify this as part of a latent skill dimension.

Using the CivilComments dataset for binary toxicity classification of online comments to assess models, grouping the results via exploratory factor analysis into a 'Social / Ethical Judgment' latent skill.
